user.title: SSE eZóna login
user.description: Sign in with the username (e-mail) and password of your SSE eZóna account. Accounts that sign in through Google, Facebook or Apple, or that require a one-time code, aren't supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SSE eZóna again
reauth_confirm.description: eZóna rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current password.

delivery_points.title: Delivery points
delivery_points.description: Choose the delivery points to add. You can change this later in the integration's options.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach eZóna. Try again later.
error.unsupported_login: This account needs a one-time code to sign in, which isn't supported.
error.no_delivery_points: This account has no electricity delivery points.
error.no_selection: Choose at least one delivery point.

init.title: Delivery points
init.description: Choose the delivery points to add. You can change this later in the integration's options.

energy_aid.title: Energy aid
energy_aid.description: For each delivery point, choose whether the targeted energy aid (adresná energopomoc) is subtracted from its prices. The prices in eZóna don't include it. Automatic follows "Nárok na adresnú energopomoc" in eZóna.

data_description.energy_aid_amount: Leave empty to use the amount set by law for the current year (31.24 €/MWh in 2026).

error.no_selection: Choose at least one delivery point.

abort.not_loaded: The integration isn't loaded. Fix the problem shown for it first.
